name: Ring-2.6-1T
short: InclusionAI's trillion-parameter open-weight reasoning flagship (1T total / 63B active) — the thinking half of the 2.6-1T pair with adjustable Reasoning Effort (high/xhigh).
pricingNote: AA ~$0.30/$2.50 per 1M; MIT open weights, but self-hosting needs ~32 GPUs (vendor SGLang example: 4 nodes x 8)
freeTierNote: Free OpenRouter endpoint at $0.00/1M; no Zen Free ID. Hugging Face reports no Inference Provider deploys the weights directly.
